plugins.name: soul-system
plugins.description: The /soul-* commands, the pre-completion verification hook (the Stop gate), and an experimental secret guard on git commit/push (credentials block, private names warn; needs gitleaks and git 2.31+). Run /soul-init to wire the project contract (operations/CLAUDE.md) into your project's CLAUDE.md via @import.
